NOFX_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Login email for the single NOFX account, created on first boot so nobody else can register first

NOFX_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Login password, set on first boot only - copy it from here to log in

DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts the exchange and AI keys you save - auto-generated; never change it or saved keys stop decrypting

CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Origins allowed to call the API - add your custom domain here if you set one

TRANSPORT_ENCRYPTION.description: Browser encrypts API keys before sending them (needs HTTPS, which Railway provides)

EXPERIENCE_IMPROVEMENT.description: Anonymous usage stats to the NOFX team - set true to opt in

TZ.description: Time zone for logs and trade history, e.g. Europe/Berlin

PORT.description: Port the web UI listens on - leave as is
